requirement: A GitHub Actions workflow must run checker tests and the full evidence check on pushes and pull requests, failing the job when either fails.

inputs.contents:
name: Requirement evidence

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable

jobs:
  evidence:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install stable Rust
        run: rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
      - name: Test the checker
        run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml
      - name: Test the shared requirement parser and renderer
        run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path mdbook-language-lab/Cargo.toml
      - name: Test the language tutor CLI
        run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path skills/language-lab/cli/Cargo.toml
      - name: Test the packaged skill and version agreement
        run: python3 skills/language-lab/tests/test_package.py
      - name: Check every requirement's evidence
        run: cargo run --locked --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml -- check

justification: Scenarios assessed before review: push and pull-request triggers, checker tests, unfiltered complete evidence check, and propagation of failed commands. The workflow declares both triggers and runs both required commands with normal GitHub Actions fail-on-error behavior; it has no continue-on-error or failure-masking shell operation. The subprocess regression proves the checker exits nonzero and reports multiple missing requirements; main propagates validation failures. All 20 checker tests passed locally. Workflow structure was parsed successfully as YAML. Hosted execution will occur on push; no remote success is claimed.
